description: This header defines the API and data structures for managing dynamic, NULL-terminated arrays of strings, called 'strvec'. It provides functions for initialization, modification (push, insert, replace, remove), splitting, and cleanup of string vectors, facilitating flexible manipulation of string collections suitable for argument passing and similar tasks.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure, setting its members to default values.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string onto the end of the array.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes an allocated string onto the array, taking ownership of the provided string.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-style formatting and pushes it onto the array.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a variable list of strings onto the array, terminated by NULL.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings onto the array.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the array with new strings, inserting or deleting as specified.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specific index with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the string at a specific index, shifting subsequent elements.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the array.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string by whitespace and pushes tokens into the array.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the array and resets it.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying array from the strvec, transferring ownership to the caller.
